svg.text: Native RLL · 16 source / 16 displayed rungs · full · Programs/Automatic_Cycle/Routines/WH_SendSignals · a200dec80c06b39817c5
ADDED · Initialize new source epoch; source edges present at startup are not replayed.
ADDED · Increment sender boot epoch once.
ADDED · Epoch exhaustion requires a new installation.
ADDED · Capture the actual source rising edge; keep its timestamp until the next edge.
ADDED · Do not wrap event identities.
ADDED · Timestamp in this source controller before any network delay; event counter commits last.
ADDED · Set the independent cycle-start stopwatch range from the controller constant.
ADDED · Initialize the separate cycle-start stopwatch.
ADDED · Actual CDL transfer start resets the new cycle-start stopwatch.
ADDED · Continue timing after legacy gripper release; FDC ends the handled-part display on Cycle Start or return.
ADDED · Transport the source-measured elapsed value, not a receiver-clock subtraction.
ADDED · Exhausted source timer invalidates the live warning.
ADDED · Source furnace was latched by WH_CDL_Begin from original removal selection.
ADDED · Retain the actual legacy in-air transfer time, including its original release stop.
ADDED · Transport the raw legacy running flag.
ADDED · Clock validation is a commissioning setting, not a fabricated good-quality signal.
SOURCE · original PLC storage / Item InOut
Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
